info.title: HawkerHub API
info.description: API documentation for HawkerHub backend system

bearerAuth.name: Authorization
bearerAuth.description: Enter JWT token in this format: Bearer <token>

post.description: Register a new vendor account and linked stall

201.description: Vendor account and stall created successfully

post.description: Step 1 of officer login. Verifies email/password, then sends an OTP and returns a short-lived pendingToken to use with /verify-otp.

200.description: Password verified. OTP sent - use the returned pendingToken with POST /verify-otp.

post.description: Step 1 of operator login. Verifies email/password, then sends an OTP and returns a short-lived pendingToken to use with /verify-otp.

200.description: Password verified. OTP sent - use the returned pendingToken with POST /verify-otp.

post.description: Step 2 of officer/operator login. Verifies the OTP against the pendingToken from step 1, then returns the real login token.

401.description: Incorrect or expired OTP, or expired login session

post.description: Request a password reset email. Always returns a generic success message, whether or not the email exists, to prevent account enumeration.

patch.description: Reset a password using the token emailed by /forgot-password.

get.description: BED-61: List all active hawker stalls. Supports optional search and cuisine query params for BED-49 browse/filter.

parameters.name: search
parameters.description: Keyword to match against stall name / description

get.description: BED-62: Get a specific stall\'s menu items (dishes, prices, descriptions).
BED-85: Get the aggregated average rating, total review count, and most recent reviews for a stall.
Vendor retrieves orders from stalls they own
Vendor retrieves details of one order from their own stall

put.description: Vendor updates the status of an order from their own stall

400.description: Invalid order ID or invalid order status

404.description: Order not found or vendor does not own this stall

post.description: Patron creates an order for a single stall. If a promo_code is supplied, the backend validates its active status, expiry date and minimum spend, calculates the exact discount server-side, applies it to the order total, and records a redemption linked to this order - preventing the same code from being reused. Invalid/expired/ineligible codes return a clear error reason instead of failing the order.

Patron previews what a promo code would do to their current cart (for one stall) without submitting an order. Returns the same validation reasons as order creation (NOT_FOUND, INACTIVE, EXPIRED, MIN_SPEND_NOT_MET, ALREADY_REDEEMED, LIMIT_REACHED) if invalid, or the calculated discount if valid. No order is created and no redemption is recorded.

get.description: Patron retrieves their own past orders, newest first
Patron retrieves all their orders that share one checkout id (combined receipt)
Patron retrieves the status of one of their own orders
Patron retrieves one of their own orders with its line items
Get logged-in user profile

patch.description: Deactivate the logged-in user account without deleting historical records

404.description: Account not found or already deactivated

post.description: BED-2: Submit a rating and comment for a stall. Registered patrons only - guests are rejected.

get.description: BED-2: Vendor retrieves feedback left for their own stall(s) only.

put.description: BED-92: Edit your own feedback. Returns 403 if the feedback belongs to a different patron.

comment.example: Updated my review after a second visit.

delete.description: BED-92: Delete your own feedback. Returns 403 if the feedback belongs to a different patron.

post.description: A registered user submits a complaint against a stall (details, date, complaint text). On success, a unique tracking id is generated and the complaint is created with a default "Open" status, so the user knows their complaint was officially received.

get.description: Officer/operator retrieves the list of complaints they are responsible for (officers see Hygiene complaints, operators see every other type), with optional filtering by status or stall.
Officer/operator retrieves the full detail of a single complaint they are responsible for, including its resolution notes.

patch.description: Officer/operator updates a complaint they are responsible for - moving its status (e.g. Open -> In Progress -> Resolved) and appending a resolution note - closing the loop from initial submission to final resolution.

get.description: Vendor lists complaints that have been filed against their own stalls, so they can stay aware of open issues.
Vendor retrieves the detail of one complaint filed against their own stall.

patch.description: Vendor acknowledges a complaint filed against their own stall, confirming they have seen it. This does not change the complaint status or resolution, which remain under officer/operator control.

get.description: Vendor lists all promotion codes for one of their own stalls, so they can review what is currently running before creating or editing a code.

post.description: Vendor creates a new promotion code for their own stall (code, discount percentage, validity dates). The code only needs to be unique within that stall - a duplicate code is rejected with a validation error, but two different stalls may use the same code.

get.description: Vendor retrieves a single promotion code belonging to them, including its current active status and validity dates.

put.description: Vendor updates one of their own promotion codes, e.g. toggling it active/inactive. This never deletes the promotion record - historical promotion data is always preserved.

delete.description: Vendor deletes one of their own promotion codes, but ONLY if it was never actually redeemed by a patron. Once a promo has real order/redemption history attached, it can only be deactivated via the update route, never deleted.

post.description: NEA officer schedules an inspection for a valid stall

get.description: NEA officer views inspection records, optionally filtered by stall ID
NEA officer views upcoming scheduled inspections

put.description: NEA officer reschedules an existing scheduled inspection

delete.description: NEA officer deletes/cancels a scheduled inspection using soft delete

patch.description: NEA officer cancels a scheduled inspection
NEA officer records inspection result and hygiene grade

remarks.example: Stall is clean and food preparation area is well maintained.

post.description: BED-26: Like a menu item. Registered patrons only - guests are rejected.

delete.description: BED-26: Remove your like from a menu item.

get.description: BED-26: Get the total like count for a menu item. Public - no auth required.

post.description: Patron saves a new delivery address

get.description: Patron retrieves all of their saved delivery addresses

put.description: Patron updates one of their saved delivery addresses

delete.description: Patron deletes one of their saved delivery addresses
